reviews.text:
Lulu absolutely loves her weekly adventure days with Jared and the rest of the pack! Lulu is an Australian Shepherd who requires a lot of exercise and attention, and Jared gives her just that.

Every adventure day, Jared takes the time to keep the group updated on what the dogs have been up to and sends plenty of photos along the way. He takes such great care of them, and if needed, even cleans them up before dropping them home, which is very appreciated after a particularly muddy adventure!

Lulu always comes home happy and exhausted, which is exactly what we want! We feel completely comfortable knowing she’s in Jared’s care and couldn’t recommend his adventure days enough.

We love the Chicago Adventure Pack! I’m very picky when it comes to pet care but I feel super comfortable leaving my dog, Noodle, in Jared’s care. She’s always excited to see him and you can tell that Jared truly, genuinely cares for the dogs. The adventure days are a blast and Noodle comes home happy and tired. I recommend the Chicago adventure pack to all my pet parent friends!

Chicago Adventure Pack is truly a unique doggy daycare experience. As an owner to a dog that isn't super social, I was so grateful to find Jared and the pack. It allows my dog, Rico, to get as much social time as he chooses while being outside and getting in sniffs, lots of miles, and the freedom to explore. It's the perfect way to tire him out when I have to be in the office all day and have evening plans so I know that he'll be exhausted and just want to snooze when he comes home. It makes me happy knowing that he's getting the proper enrichment without him having to feel overwhelmed. It also keeps him fit and provides a good change of scenery for a dog that often just wants to be a couch potato. The adventure pack pricing is great, and Jared keeps you updated throughout the day. The videos of all the dogs bring such joy and really take you along for the ride.

We’ve had such a great experience with Jared and his all-day adventure walks! Our dog absolutely loves his days with him. He always comes home happy, tired, and goes straight to the couch for a well-earned nap.

One of the things we appreciate most is the smaller group setting compared to a traditional daycare. The dogs get to spend the entire day outside exploring, playing, and enjoying adventures instead of being indoors most of the time. It’s clear our dog gets both great exercise and enrichment. He also sends video updates throughout the day which always brings a smile when watching them from work.

Another thing we’ve really appreciated is that Jared has rinsed our dog off after muddy/beach days when we’re not home to meet them. It’s such a thoughtful touch and makes coming home to a happy (and mostly sand-free!) dog even better.

We highly recommend Jared to anyone looking for a fun, active, and personalized experience for their dog. It’s been a wonderful alternative to daycare, and we couldn’t be happier!

We have been sending our 7 month old pup, Lincoln, with Jared for about 2 months now on an adventure day once a week. He absolutely adores Jared, the pack, and all the adventures they go on. From pick up to drop off, Lincoln is always so excited and i can tell each time he comes home that he’s had a great day. He even learned to swim with the pack. I love receiving constant updates and pictures of Lincoln and the pack. Couldn’t recommend adventure days and Jared more and know Lincoln and the pups are in great hands.
Neo loves hanging with Jared and the crew for all day adventures. We love our real time updates and the fact that Neo comes home completely exhausted from his travels. Highly recommend. 🐶
Annie was the best! Took such great care of our pup, sent us lots of updates, and made him feel at home!

Jared has done an amazing job with Maeby. She usually takes some time to feel comfortable around new people, but she took to Jared right away and has loved her walks with him and his pups. Jared is communicative, flexible and clearly cares about the dogs he works with. I greatly appreciate all he does to ensure Maeby has a positive experience.

Jared is great! Our dog, Arlo, seems to love him and we are so grateful for his adventure days. We call it the "Jared effect" when she comes home from a whole day with him and is exhausted. He's easy to communicate with, keeps us updated on Arlo throughout the day, and his services are reasonably priced for what we get: a happy dog!
We were previously sending her to an indoor daycare, which she really seemed to dislike so we are so glad that we found Jared.

Jared’s Dog Adventures has been amazing for our pup! Our one-year-old, Remi (schnoodle), absolutely loves her adventure days. Jared picks the dogs up in his van and takes them on the best outings—she gets to run, play, and socialize with all kinds of dogs, which has been incredible for her energy and happiness.

What really stands out is how much care Jared puts into everything. If Remi gets dirty (which she often does after a full day of fun), he makes sure she’s cleaned up before bringing her home. It’s such a thoughtful touch and makes a huge difference.

Jared is kind, passionate, and incredibly organized—you can tell he genuinely loves animals and treats every dog like his own. We feel completely comfortable and grateful knowing Remi is in such good hands. Highly recommend!

It has been amazing finding Jared and his Adventure Days for our Small Munsterlander Herman. Jared loves dogs; the care and attention he provides really shows.

Herman goes on two to three all-day adventures each week with a well-matched group of dogs in dog-friendly areas. Jared sends regular updates in the WhatsApp chat, including videos, so we can see how much fun Herman is having. He always comes home happy, content, and completely exhausted.

Jared also recently organized a happy hour to bring together clients and their dogs, which was such a fun and thoughtful touch. It really shows the sense of community he’s building.

Herman is a high-energy hunting breed, and Jared provides exactly the kind of activity and stimulation he needs.

Jared is always prompt and communicates clearly about pickup and drop-off. I’ve already recommended him to several friends and would highly recommend him to anyone looking for exceptional care for their dog.

Jared has been great with helping take care of my animals when I've gone out of town. Jared also organizes dog adventure days, and my husky Crash loves going on these and playing with his doggo friends! Highly recommend, Jared is communicative and the pricing structure is fair. Plus the peace of mind knowing that my dog is well taken care of is priceless!

Started working with Jared after moving to the city, and it has been such a great experience. We switched from indoor daycare to the all day Adventure Days, and my dog Buddy is loving it so much more. He comes home completely tired, sleeps great, and is clearly getting the exercise and stimulation he needs. You can tell Jared genuinely cares about the dogs and makes sure they have a fun, active day. Jared is trustworthy and is best with communicating. So happy we made the switch!

Jared’s Dog Walking and All Day Adventures has been a complete game‑changer for our pup, Walter! From the very first meet‑and‑greet, it was clear that Jared brings an incredible mix of professionalism, warmth, and genuine love for animals. Our dog lights up the moment Jared arrives — tail wagging, paws dancing, completely thrilled for the day ahead.
The “All Day Adventures” are truly that: real adventures. Walter comes home happy, exercised, mentally stimulated, and wonderfully tired (the good kind of tired!). Jared captures the best moments throughout the day with photos and updates, which gives us total peace of mind and lets us feel like we’re part of the fun.
What sets Jared apart is the level of care and attention he gives every single dog. He learns each dog’s personality, quirks, and preferences, and tailors the day to make sure they’re safe, comfortable, and having a blast. It’s rare to find someone who treats your dog like family — but that’s exactly what Jared does.
Reliable, communicative, trustworthy, and truly passionate about what he does. If you’re looking for someone who will give your dog the absolute best day ever, Jared’s Dog Walking and All Day Adventures is the perfect match. Highly recommend!

I'm so glad we found Jared's Dog Walking and All Day Adventures--Jared has been an absolute godsend. We recently moved from the suburbs to the city, and our Boxer-Beagle mix (Gracie) was struggling a little with the move, feeling a lot more unsettled and a little down. Jared's all day adventures have cheered her right up. After 2 weeks of his fun adventures, she's right back to normal, feeling SO MUCH calmer and happier. And I give Jared ALL the credit for this.

It just warms my heart when I see his many photo and video updates while they're out on their adventures and I can see her having so much fun running around with her new pack of friends. I have to admit, sometimes I feel jealous that she's out there having the time of her life while I'm stuck at my desk working! And she's seen way more of the great Chicago outdoors than I have!

This is a little pricier than we used to have to pay for doggie daycare, but well worth the money. It's so much more enriching and your dog will get SUCH personalized attention and love from Jared. He truly is a wonderful soul. And sometimes they're tired out for two days after a big adventure! Highly, highly recommend his services. He's always responsive and on-time and really caring.

Jared is such a great guy! He has helped me find walkers for my 5 month old lab multiple times and is working with me to potentially get him into a modified adventure day! Overall 10/10 experience with him! Highly recommend:)

Jared took our Pomsky for daily walks recently while we were away for a few days. He and his team communicated throughout with timing updates, as well as sending live images, making sure she was well taken care of on her walks, and sharing it with us in real time. She also joined the dog daycare outings on the days it was offered, getting plenty of running and outdoor excitement with fellow canines. It is apparent that Jared cares deeply about dogs, and particularly the dogs in his care. All in all, it was a very good experience, and we look forward to work with Jared and his team again.
We send our dog Murphy on extended walks and also adventure days with Jared. Jared loves dogs and takes great care of them, and Murphy never wants to say bye to Jared! Thanks Jared and team.

We recently enrolled our Westie terrier Ginny in Jared's weekly walks and adventures. Jared and his team are super caring, and their communication is fantastic. Ginny comes home tired and happy! Additionally, the pricing is quite reasonable, especially given the high quality of service provided. We strongly recommend Jared and his team to other dog owners!

Jared has done an amazing job with DK. We use Jared for his All-Day Adventure outings, and he always sends video updates in the WhatsApp group, which we love. DK is always so happy to see Jared, and he has an incredible time on the adventure days. He comes home tired, socialized, and fulfilled, and it’s clear how much he enjoys bonding with the other dogs. We can’t thank Jared enough for the care and attention he gives DK. Highly recommended!

I cannot recommend Jared highly enough! He has been absolutely wonderful with my dog Tibby. As a border collie, Tibby has endless energy, but Jared somehow manages to bring her home completely happy and exhausted after adventure days, which is no small feat! Twice a week, he takes her out for 5+ hours of running, exploring, and pure joy.

Jared is incredibly kind, truly reliable, and you can tell he genuinely loves every dog in his care. Tibby gets so excited to see him, and I have total peace of mind knowing she’s out having the best time.
Jared has done a great job with Zoe, he always communicates clearly and sends pictures and videos of the walk. Highly recommend Jared.

Jared has done an amazing job with our Aussiedoodle, Savannah! He is always on time, dependable, and communicative. Jared walks Savannah every Wednesday and takes her on the all-day adventures on Tuesdays and Thursdays. He often brings her to Lincoln Park or Montrose Dog Beach, where she gets plenty of exercise and playtime. We had been taking Savannah to a normal dog daycare and noticed she began picking up some bad habits which was frustrating for us as new parents. Savannah now gets hands on attention with Jared and constant supervised play and always comes home tired, happy, and excited for her next adventure. It’s been such a relief and joy finding Jared — highly recommend!

We use Jared for our 6yo Golden Retriever and she loves her adventure day. Jared typically picks her up by 10 and she is out and about all day, enjoying parks and the dog beach. Jared sends videos via WhatsApp and is always willing to go above and beyond, even bathing Lu after a particularly sandy adventure. He is transparent, communicative, and most importantly, he loves our Lu. We could not recommend him enough!

We adopted a VERY rambunctious Great Dane and needed some help with walks and an overnight stay while we figured out his needs in his new home! Jared and his teammate Melissa did a great job with walks for Scooter! Scooter needs an experienced walker and we were happy to put our trust in his care and he completely delivered. He's a strong boy and needs someone who is experienced with dogs and can redirect him appropriately. Scooter had so much fun on his walks with Jared and he sent us so many photos and videos! He even got a pup cup ;) We also needed a trusted sitter for Scooter when we went out of town  for a weekend. Melissa, one of Jared's team members, did a great job. She came over for a meet and greet, reviewed the care plan, and made sure she knew his routine before accepting. Scooter absolutely loved her and she made our weekend away stress free! While Scooter is now a daycare boy, we absolutely will rely on them to walk and watch him when the needs arise. Thanks Jared!!

Jared has done the most amazing job with Mushkie it’s clear how much they love each other. Jared has stayed at my house overnight and takes good care of my house. I trust him implicitly and can’t say enough good things. He is truly a special person and dog care provider. Who you can rely upon always. Thank you!

Jared was great! He first came to our place to meet our dog, who was quick to befriend him. We use Jared for his dog walking services, and he’s very communicative, and quick to respond. Jared also sends great and frequent photo and video updates when he’s with our dog. Will definitely be using him again.

I have worked with Jared and his team including Dariusz and Anna over the last few weeks and they have done an absolutely phenomenal job caring for my puppy Navy! They are communicative and responsive and punctual and always send lots of updates on how much fun Navy is having during her play dates. I am truly grateful to have found Jared and will be sending Navy on all day adventures and walks and play dates in the future!
Jared was great. He was very attentive to our three dogs, reliable and responsible. We highly recommend him!

Jared took incredible care of my dog. He sent me videos throughout the day showing how happy and active she was, which gave me real peace of mind. It’s clear he genuinely loves dogs and treats them like family. I highly recommend Jared’s Dog Walking and All Day Adventures to anyone in Chicago looking for someone reliable, caring, and attentive.

Jared and his partner Dariusz were both awesome. They walked, played, spent time with and fed our 1.5 year old chocolate lab (a couple times) this past Saturday while we were at a wedding. Both were very responsive and provided multiple videos and pictures of our pup. Overall a very easy and stress-free experience, and our dog looked very happy in the videos! Highly recommend, we’ll be using them again

Jared & his team did an OUTSTANDING JOB! I was in a pinch with travel plans and with less than a days notice they were able to communicate with me and take care of our best bud!

They sent live updates during the walk with videos & photos. Sent text communication, were able to pick him up and drop him off without trouble. 10/5 STARS!!!

Jared recently walked my dog Beans for a couple days over the weekend and was great to work with. He replied to my request quickly and was eager to know everything about my dog's needs. Beans is a young dog and has a lot of energy, but Jared seemed to handle him very well. Plus he sent tons of pictures, videos, and text updates to let me know how Beans was doing.

I only asked for a couple 30 minute walks for my dog, and I think Jared spent 3 whole hours walking beans and giving him plenty of exercise and time with the other dogs.

We will definitely have Jared walk Beans for us again whenever Beans needs some extra exercise and fun!

Jared is terrific with our Labradoodle, Zeus. From the moment we got in touch, Jared was enthusiastic, responsive, and eager to meet Zeus. He came to our home in Lakeview and instantly connected with Zeus.

Jared  takes Zeus on long walks and sends videos of Zeus adventuring through Lincoln Park, walking with his pack. He’s on time, communicative, and dependable. Zeus looks forward to his time with Jared and is happily tired afterward. On his last walk, we got a video of Zeus with Jared’s dog, Parker, running alongside Jared on a scooter. Zeus typically hates scooters and lunges at them — how Jared managed to get Zeus to just trot along happily is a mystery?!

We’re so glad we found Jared — he’s become a trusted part of Zeus’s life and we couldn’t be happier.

Jared has done an amazing job taking care of our German Shepherd, Lea.
We first met at North Pond Dog Park, and it was immediately clear how much he genuinely loves dogs. Jared’s communication is top-notch, he always sends me the sweetest videos of Lea, and keeps me updated throughout the day.

One day he even walked her all the way from Lincoln Park to Navy Pier and back on a four-hour adventure! I’ve been truly impressed by his professionalism, reliability, and ability to handle multiple dogs at once with confidence and care.

We feel so lucky to have found him!

Jared has been such a blessing for Harper and our family! From the very first walk, I could tell how much he truly cares about the dogs he works with. He takes Harper on long, enriching walks where she gets both exercise and mental stimulation, and he always sends updates, photos, and videos — which I really appreciate!

Harper can be a little shy at first, but she absolutely lights up when she sees Jared. She’s not just being walked — she’s genuinely being cared for, and I feel totally at ease knowing she’s in such good hands.

Jared is also incredibly reliable, professional, and flexible with our schedule. Whether it’s a last-minute booking or a weekend overnight, I know I can count on him.

Thank you, Jared, for treating Harper like one of your own. We’re so grateful to have found you!

— Renee

There aren’t enough words to express what an amazing job Jared does with my recently rescued Pomsky, Dixie, from PAWS Chicago. He always sends plenty of photos and videos, communicates when he’s on the way, and makes sure I feel totally in the loop. He even offers a discount for PAWS Chicago members, which speaks to how deeply committed he is—not just to the dogs he walks, but to rescue organizations like PAWS and One Tail at a Time.

Dixie and I feel so lucky to have found him! She has been going on multiple beach days and fun outings with other dogs, and it’s been incredible to see her making friends and coming out of her shell. Jared sends me thoughtful updates after every adventure, and it’s clear how much he cares about her. Their bond is growing, and it honestly melts my heart to see how sweet he is with her. So grateful Dixie is in his care—thank you, Jared!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Jared has been absolutely amazing with my dog, Milo! Milo can sometimes be reactive on walks and a little anxious in the car, but Jared handles him with such patience and positive reinforcement. He gives Milo the exercise he needs, keeps him hydrated, and always updates me with detailed notes, photos, and videos so I know how he’s doing.

Milo has gone on multiple adventures with Jared — from River North to Old Town and Lincoln Park — and he always comes home happy and tired. I can tell Jared genuinely cares about Milo and treats him like his own dogs. He’s reliable, trustworthy, and goes the extra mile (literally and figuratively!).

I highly recommend Jared’s Dog Walking & Boarding to anyone looking for safe, loving, and professional care. Milo and I are so lucky to have found him!

Jared has taken great care of our pup! He takes her, along with a few other great dogs, on adventures throughout the neighborhood, including parks and the beach. She comes home tired and content. Jared is super responsive and seems to have a genuine love for and commitment to the wellbeing of dogs!!

I am always skeptical letting a stranger into my home but Jared has shown me that he is very trustworthy . Jared comes and takes my dog out for a walk 1-2 times a week while I go to the office. He sends tons of videos and pictures of my dogs progress throughout the day and seems to genuinely care about all dogs. I will keep using his services and I like that he does it full time. I’ve gone through college students, teachers, and others that do dog walking as a wig but they turn out to be less reliable as it conflicts with their schedules. Jared is very flexible and willing to take care of my dog any time I ask. Thank you Jared.
Jared was wonderful with my two pups! my first experience couldn’t have gone better! lots of fun videos sent! lots of play time! can’t wait to use again

Jared did a fantastic job watching our 5 month old puppy Chloe!! He took her to the dog beach and she swam and ran around with his dogs! She was so tired the next day she had to take multiple naps. Jared sent endless videos and pictures, I know our pup was in the best hands! I would recommend Jared to any dog owner!! He’s the best

Jared has been great with our medium sized bernedoodle. We let Jared know he has some anxiety and doesn’t love being around other dogs on walks. He has shown so much patience, care, and affection, and Louis just adores him. Jared goes above and beyond on every walk making sure Louis is safe, happy, and well exercised. He even takes him on fun little adventures stopping into dog-friendly spots like Stan’s Donuts and Mariano’s to keep things interesting.

I especially appreciate Jared’s attention to detail. He always makes sure Louis is comfortable, hydrated, and loved before he leaves, and he communicates clearly with updates and photos so I know how the walk went. Louis has truly become a star on Jared’s Instagram page, which makes me smile every time I see him featured.

I highly recommend Jared for anyone looking for a trustworthy, reliable, and genuinely caring dog walker.

Jared did an amazing job with Cooper! He arrived on time to go over Cooper’s care instructions, and then stayed overnight to make sure Cooper was happy and comfortable. Throughout the stay, Jared sent me plenty of photos and videos so I could see how much fun Cooper was having. He kept Cooper’s water bowl full, fed him according to instructions, and gave him lots of love and attention.

I’ll definitely be using Jared again when I leave in September . Cooper had such a great experience, and I had total peace of mind. Thank you, Jared!

We have known Jared for a few years as the property owner at our place in Lincoln Park. Over that time, we entrusted him several times to walk our golden retriever, Walter, and he always took such great care of him. We know Jared in multiple respects—as both a property owner and our dog walker—and he has always proven to be very trustworthy.

He sent us detailed report cards after Walter’s walks, making sure he was not only well cared for but also having fun, getting some jogging in, and even visiting with our neighbors. Jared is simply the best, and we highly recommend him!
Jared was great with Lilo! Highly recommend

I’ve known Jared for a few years and always knew how much he loves dogs, so when I needed someone to walk Walter, I trusted him right away. Jared did such a great job — he sent me a detailed report card after the walk, shared videos during, and even showed the total distance and time they walked. He’s friendly, professional, and clearly cares about the dogs he works with. I highly recommend him!

Jared took care of Ziya many times, and we trusted him like no other dog sitter. During our time in Ann Arbor, we became close friends, and I would trust Jared with Ziya any day. He took her on day-long adventures to the golf course, dog parks, and everywhere in between, always sending us lots of cute photos and videos.

We relied on him for both daycare and overnight boarding, and he always went above and beyond. Even now, we remain close friends, and I can confidently say Jared is a wonderful person who truly loves and cares for dogs. I wholeheartedly recommend him for dog walking, boarding, or adventure days with Ziya. Thank you, Jared!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Jared did such an amazing job taking care of Chloe! She had the absolute best time during her stay. From swimming at Lake Michigan, going to dog-friendly events, and exploring Millennium Park, to playing endless games of fetch in Lincoln Park she was always happy and well cared for. Jared sent tons of photos and videos that showed just how much fun Chloe was having, and it gave me so much peace of mind while I was away.

Chloe came home tired, happy, and clearly loved every minute of her adventure-filled days. Jared went above and beyond in making sure she was comfortable, exercised, and treated like family. I highly recommend him to anyone looking for boarding, dog walks, or all-day adventures. I’ll definitely be booking with Jared again in the future. He is truly fantastic with dogs and cares for them like his own.
We are repeat customers. Jared genuinely cares about our fur baby, Rue. He provides us with regular updates, cute pictures and videos throughout the entire walk. Thank you, Jared!

Jared did an amazing job caring for my dog, Ryley, over a long weekend. He met with me beforehand to introduce the dogs and make sure they got along, and asked thoughtful questions about Ryley’s preferences.

He was on time for drop-off and immediately communicated how much he enjoyed Ryley’s company, even sending updates of her cuddling with him on the couch. Throughout the weekend, he played indoor fetch with her and his dog and took her on a bunch of adventures — including a beach day and a dog park. Got so many pictures and videos of them having fun and Ryley riding around town on his lap in the car :)

You could tell how much Jared truly cared for Ryley and how much she loved being with him. She had the best time ever, and I will absolutely be entrusting Jared with her care going forward!

Jared has walked Mozart several times and it’s clear he has a genuine affection for him and for all dogs! He truly goes the extra mile, even walking Mozart past midnight and as late as 11 p.m. recently. He often offers to take Mozart on longer walks, sometimes adding an extra hour without asking for additional payment, simply because he enjoys spending time with him.

I’m impressed by Jared’s dedication and his love for Mozart. Mozart always looks forward to seeing him!
Jared is the best! My dog Pete LOVES his walks with Jared and the pack. You can tell he has a true passion for dogs. He will take care of your dog like his own.

If there’s one person I’d trust implicitly to care for a dog, it’s Jared. His energy is absolutely magnetic—joyful, grounded, and full of heart—and animals feel it immediately. You can see how dogs light up around him. He has this effortless way of making them feel safe, seen, and totally loved.

What makes Jared stand out isn’t just his reliability or professionalism (though he has those in spades), it’s the genuine connection he builds. He brings the perfect balance of playfulness and calm, and I’ve watched him interact with dogs in a way that’s truly intuitive and attuned.

Whether your dog needs an adventure buddy, a trustworthy walker, or just someone who will show up with love and presence every time, Jared is it. His passion for what he does radiates through everything—and any pup would be lucky to have him in their pack.
Jared loves dogs 🐶 more than anyone I know! …

Jared is one of the kindest and most loving people to all animals that you’ll ever meet! He is very reliable and able to handle all sorts of different pet situations to take care of your animal friends. Highly recommend, Jared! 10/10.

If you're looking for quality dog walking and pet care, look no further than Jared. I can say with full confidence that Jared cares deeply for animals and has been active in the dog rescue community for years, in addition to his work with PAWS Chicago and other notable organizations. I'd highly recommend Jared for any pet-related services. Your furry friends will be in great hands!

Over the years, Jared has not only been a kind and passionate friend but he’s also been somebody who has taken a very kind heart to every animal he encounters. I had Jared watch my dog while a family vacation and when leaving him there not only did I know that he was gonna get the care he needed, he was also gonna get the attention, love and outdoor time that he deserved. Thank you so much Jared, we will definitely be back!

I’ve known Jared for many years and know how much he genuinely cares about animals. His love for them really comes through in how he connects with pets, especially dogs. He’s dedicated to great service, often walking 15 miles or more per day with the dogs around Chicago. His heart is in the right place, and he brings a lot of enthusiasm and compassion to animal care. I’d recommend him to someone looking for a pet caregiver with a strong bond to animals.

Jared takes a great care of my pups! Every walk he makes sure they’re safe, have plenty of water, ac (ok an hot day), socialization and love. We’ve met during one of my walks, and since day one me and  my pups loved Jared. You truly see how much he loves dogs. If you need someone to walk your pup(s) and feel confident that your dogs are truly taken care of, Jared is your man!

I have watched Jared develop a deep true love of animals and particularly dogs over his life. He has devoted many hours of his time volunteering at rescue centers taking care of all types of dogs as well as raising money for their benefit, including running marathons! He instantly puts any dog at ease with his loving ways towards them.
You can’t find a better care giver for your beloved canine as he will truly treat them as family.

I’ve known Jared for over 15 years, and one thing that’s always stood out is his genuine love for animals—especially rescues. His kindness, reliability, and commitment to every dog he cares for make him someone I’d trust with my own pets in a heartbeat. Highly recommend!
